text:
The cardiac cycle runs through atrial systole, isovolumetric ventricular contraction, ventricular ejection, isovolumetric ventricular relaxation, and ventricular filling. Systole is the contraction sequence (isovolumetric contraction and ejection); diastole is the relaxation and filling sequence, including the slower late-filling interval. Each cycle moves blood from the atria through the ventricles into the arteries.

CONFIDENCE: 91
